verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents LLM-oriented sizing: an `output=md` mode "optimized for LLMs and AI agents" at roughly half the tokens of JSON, available on every API, plus a field-selection parameter that trims the payload. It also markets RAG as a use case. However, results are only SERP snippets in the search engine's own order, with no evidence of relevance re-ranking, page-content extraction or chunking for LLM context. missing for 10: relevance ranking tuned for LLM/RAG context, full-page content extraction or chunking, token-budget controls, independent hands-on corroboration of RAG use.
